chip.opts.sim: testbench (module), defines {{NAME: value}}, plusargs ["+x=1"]. Icarus wuxuu ku daraa module yar oo qoraa dhammaan signal-yada out/wave.vcd; Verilator wuxuu muujiyaa mawjadaha kaliya marka testbench-kaagu yeedho $dumpfile.
chip.opts.synth: liberty (fayl .lib ah oo mashruuca ka mid ah), period (ns), flatten (true/false), exclude [files], script (script-kaaga .ys).

chip.opts.drc: gds (naqshadda), deck (deck-ka DRC ee PDK-gaaga), top (cell), vars {{input, report, topcell}}: magacyada ay deck-ku akhrido.
chip.opts.lvs: layout (netlist la soo saaray), layoutCell, schematic (netlist), schematicCell, setup (faylka habaynta Netgen ee PDK-kaaga).
chip.opts.gls: netlist, cells [moodalyada unugyada PDK-kaaga], sdf (laga soo saaray goobaynta iyo xidhiidhka), dut (tusaalaha, tusaale ahaan counter_tb.dut).
chip.opts.stil: Sida simulation-ka heer albaab (ama naqshadda RTL haddii aan netlist jirin), iyo period iyo strobe (unugyada waqtiga dump-ka), scope, inputs [], outputs [], clock [names].
